svg.metadata: {"id": "ATLAS_A", "class": "CONCEPTUAL", "claims": ["CL01"], "sources": ["specs/current_architecture_lock_v01.md"], "assertion": "Independent local owners accept their own work and actions.", "nodes": ["INTENT", "MODEL", "VENUE", "REQUESTER", "WORK", "ROOT", "MEMORY", "FIREWALL"], "relations": [["VENUE", "REQUESTER", "DATA"], ["MODEL", "WORK", "PROPOSAL"], ["WORK", "ROOT", "DATA"], ["MEMORY", "ROOT", "DATA"], ["ROOT", "FIREWALL", "PERMISSION"], ["FIREWALL", "WORK", "EXECUTION"]], "meaning": "The first Work returns evidence. The effect lane denotes separately authorized bounded work after a current Root packet, not permission for the first proposal. Repeat this local pattern for independent owners; no edge grants authority from one Root to another.", "omitted_scope": "Topology and time predicates, packet internals, Root descent and provider callbacks are not fully drawn.", "rendering": {"layout": "Two local-owner columns, VenueRoot left and ActivePlanetRoot right. Shared intention/proposal line above; time/memory and child Work context below.", "graphical_arrows": [["VENUE", "REQUESTER", "DATA"]], "text_flows": ["Each column: local Work result to its own Root review.", "Left column: Permission/current packet to Firewall; then separate authorized execution.", "Right column: foreign approval creates no registry write permission."], "entity_instances": {"WORK": ["VenueRoot availability Work", "ActivePlanetRoot checked consumer Work", "Separate authorized effect Work"], "ROOT": ["VenueRoot local result review", "ActivePlanetRoot own local decision"]}, "legend": "Only the cross-owner DATA relation is a graphical arrow; local proposal, permission and execution relations are labelled in text. No SuperRoot."}}
svg.text: A user or event supplies an intention; semantic proposals are not permission.
No write access to venue registry
Time and local memory inform each decision; neither retains action authority.
Typed Work can compose child Work. Runtime owns topology, not final authority.
